content:
Track: SQL Foundations
   - Lesson 1: Introduction to Relational Databases
   - Lesson 2: Basic SQL SELECT Statements
   - Lesson 3: JOIN Operations and Conditional Clauses
   - Lesson 4: Understanding Data Types and Functions in SQL
   - Lesson 5: Advanced Querying Techniques (Subqueries, Common Table Expressions)
   - Lesson 6: Introduction to Database Design and Normalization
   - Lesson 7: Troubleshooting Common SQL Issues
   - Lesson 8: Working with Complex Queries: UNION, INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN, RIGHT JOIN, OUTER JOIN
   - Lesson 9: Data Manipulation Language (DML) - INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
   - Lesson 10: Aggregations and GROUP BY Clauses

   Track: Python for Data Analysis
   - Lesson 1: Introduction to Python and Jupyter Notebooks
   - Lesson 2: Basic Python Syntax: Variables, Data Types, Operators, Control Structures
   - Lesson 3: Functions and Modules in Python
   - Lesson 4: Working with Lists, Tuples, and Dictionaries
   - Lesson 5: Introduction to Pandas: Data Structures and Loading Data
   - Lesson 6: Data Manipulation with Pandas: Indexing, Slicing, Merging, and Reshaping
   - Lesson 7: Data Cleaning Techniques in Python (Handling Missing Values, Duplicates)
   - Lesson 8: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) using Pandas and Matplotlib

   Track: Intermediate SQL
   - Lesson 1: Advanced Query Optimization Techniques
   - Lesson 2: Using SQL Transactions, Views, and Stored Procedures
   - Lesson 3: Working with Large Datasets and Partitioning Strategies
   - Lesson 4: Performance Tuning for SQL Queries
   - Lesson 5: Database Administration: Backup, Restore, Security
   - Lesson 6: Database Migration Strategies
   - Lesson 7: Introduction to Entity-Relationship Modeling (ERD) and Design Patterns
   - Lesson 8: Normalization Techniques for Optimizing Data Integrity

   Track: Intermediate Python for Data Analysis
   - Lesson 1: Advanced Pandas: Time Series, Merging DataFrames, GroupBy Functions
   - Lesson 2: Introduction to Statistical Analysis and Hypothesis Testing with SciPy
   - Lesson 3: Working with APIs in Python (using requests and BeautifulSoup)
   - Lesson 4: Data Validation Techniques and Error Handling in Python
   - Lesson 5: Introduction to Machine Learning Concepts (Supervised, Unsupervised, and Reinforcement Learning)
   - Lesson 6: Preprocessing Data for Machine Learning Models (Scaling, Encoding Categorical Variables)
   - Lesson 7: Training and Evaluating Simple Machine Learning Models with Scikit-learn
   - Lesson 8: Deploying Machine Learning Models using Flask or FastAPI

   Track: Data Cleaning & Preprocessing
   - Lesson 1: Handling Missing Values in Python (Imputation Strategies)
   - Lesson 2: Data Normalization Techniques for Improving Model Performance
   - Lesson 3: Outlier Detection and Treatment Methods in Python
   - Lesson 4: Feature Engineering for Data Preprocessing
   - Lesson 5: Handling Imbalanced Datasets and Sampling Strategies
   - Lesson 6: Text Preprocessing Techniques (Tokenization, Stop Words Removal, Stemming/Lemmatization)
   - Lesson 7: Dimensionality Reduction with Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and t-SNE
   - Lesson 8: Data Balancing Techniques for Class Imbalance Problems

   Track: Data Visualization with Python (Advanced)
   - Lesson 1: Building Advanced Dashboards with Bokeh or Plotly
   - Lesson 2: Creating Interactive Maps and Geographical Visualizations in Python
   - Lesson 3: Time Series Analysis and Forecasting using Line Charts, Area Charts, and Heatmaps
   - Lesson 4: Creating Box Plots, Violin Plots, and Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) Plots
   - Lesson 5: Building Multi-Dimensional Scatter Plots with Matplotlib or Seaborn
   - Lesson 6: Creating Heatmaps for Exploring Correlation Matrix Data
   - Lesson 7: Data Storytelling and Communication Techniques in Python
   - Lesson 8: Presenting Visualizations using PowerBI, Tableau, or Google Charts

   Track: Introduction to Machine Learning with Scikit-learn
   - Lesson 1: Decision Trees (Classification and Regression)
   - Lesson 2: Logistic Regression for Binary Classification Problems
   - Lesson 3: Random Forests and Gradient Boosted Trees
   - Lesson 4: Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Kernel Trick
   - Lesson 5: Clustering Algorithms (K-Means, Hierarchical Clustering)
   - Lesson 6: Dimensionality Reduction Techniques (Principal Component Analysis, t-Distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding)
   - Lesson 7: Anomaly Detection with Isolation Forests and Local Outlier Factor
   - Lesson 8: Introduction to Ensemble Learning and Stacking Models
